notes.title: [Version 1.11 has been released] Performance optimization and adjustment
Delayed update announcement
notes.content:
Dear Immortals :

Due to the small size of our team and the lack of experience and manpower, there has been a deviation in the estimation of the version. We apologize for not being able to update on time as agreed in mid April.

Thank you for your support and expectations of 'Immortal Seeker'. We are still very happy to receive your enthusiastic updates. Please rest assured that our team is working hard to produce version 1.1, and we urgently hope to meet you as soon as possible.



Reason for delay

1. Incorrect estimation of version size (now it seems that this mode is equivalent to completing a new game);

2. After testing some content, it needs to be optimized and adjusted, hoping to bring a better experience to everyone.



Current Version Progress

We have completed the production of a new version of the system (spiritual roots and factions) and gameplay (Tongtian Tower),

And we have organized some players to experience, and after testing player feedback and our team's own testing, we are currently working on the following tasks:

1. Repairing identified issues and optimizing feedback on content with poor experience;

2. Enrich the content of the Tongtian Tower;

3. Adjust the difficulty of the Tongtian Tower.



When can we update it

I believe this is the issue that everyone is most concerned about. Based on the current progress, we will try our best to launch a new version around the end of April.
